problem.source_decision_clock: the finalized event can become available at any second within a UTC minute
problem.entry_clock: the next exact one-minute open after source availability
problem.remaining_leak: the intermediate causal engine treated the minute immediately preceding entry as completed and used its high, low and close, even though that bar is still forming when a mid-minute source event becomes available; it also used the future entry open for liquidity distances and row eligibility
problem.consequence: model probability, LONG/SHORT/FLAT utility and candidate availability could depend on information not available when the order must be frozen

frozen_fix.completed_bar_cutoff: latest bar with open_time plus 60000 milliseconds less than or equal to source decision time
frozen_fix.price_features: return, volatility, path efficiency, breadth and 60-minute liquidity pools end at that completed-bar cutoff
frozen_fix.decision_reference_price: last completed close at the cutoff
frozen_fix.target_stop_geometry: distance and utility use the decision reference price, never the future entry open
frozen_fix.entry_price: next-minute open remains only the realized execution proxy
frozen_fix.entry_gap: a preselected setup whose realized entry opens outside the frozen target-stop band is recorded as a zero-gross cost-only invalidation; no alternative candidate is selected using that future gap
frozen_fix.stage_boundary: open positions are NAV-marked, not strategy-closed
